name: registration-service-node
description: Mock Node.js backend for the Patient & Case API.

scripts.generate:api: npm --prefix ../../../packages/api-schema run --silent generate:api-schema >/dev/null && rm -rf ./src/api/openapi-client ./src/api/types.gen.ts && NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1 npx openapi-generator-cli generate -i ../../../packages/api-schema/openapi.json -g typescript-fetch -o ./src/api/openapi-client --additional-properties=typescriptThreePlus=true,withInterfaces=true,useSingleRequestParameter=true,enumPropertyNaming=original,modelPropertyNaming=original >/dev/null
